evidence_document.title: Dataset Construction and DQ Assessment – Residential Real Estate Mortgages

1.0.heading: Purpose and scope
1.0.text: This document describes the construction of the reference data set (RDS) for the PD-MORT-NL v4 model and the assessment of its data quality. It follows the RDS template of MRM-STD-021 and was approved by the Head of Retail Credit Risk Modelling on 12 June 2027 (document version 1.0).

1.0.heading: Observation period
1.0.text: The reference data set covers monthly snapshots from January 2012 to December 2024, totalling 9.6 million account-months for 780,000 unique facilities.

1.0.heading: Choice of observation window
1.0.text: The window was chosen to maximise the available history after the migration to the current mortgage administration system in 2011. It includes the 2012–2013 housing market downturn and the low-default period 2016–2021.

1.0.heading: Default definition
1.0.text: A facility is flagged as defaulted when it is more than 90 days past due above a materiality threshold of EUR 100 absolute and 1% relative, or when an unlikeliness-to-pay trigger is met.

1.0.heading: Unlikeliness-to-pay triggers
1.0.text: UTP triggers comprise distressed restructuring, forced sale of the collateral, bankruptcy of the obligor and specific credit risk adjustments. Triggers are sourced from the arrears management system and applied at obligor level.

1.0.heading: Data sources and lineage
1.0.text: All 38 candidate variables are sourced from the mortgage administration system, the arrears management system and the collateral valuation database. Lineage from source table to RDS field is documented in Annex A for every variable.

1.0.heading: Exclusions
1.0.text: Loans with incomplete collateral information were excluded from the RDS (3,412 facilities, 0.4% of the population; 61 defaults). Facilities originated under the former brand portfolio were excluded (1,208 facilities, 0.15%; 9 defaults) because origination data is unavailable. The combined exclusions affect the long-run default rate by +0.01pp.

1.0.heading: Missing values and outliers
1.0.text: Missing values for debt-to-income at origination (2.3%) are imputed with the segment median; outliers in indexed LTV above 250% are capped. Both treatments are justified in Annex C.

1.0.heading: Representativeness
1.0.text: Population stability between the RDS and the current portfolio was assessed using the PSI on loan-to-value bucket, loan age and interest-only share (PSI 0.04–0.06). Annex B adds a comparison of the full LTV distribution.

1.0.heading: Impact of exclusions
1.0.text: Excluded loans show a comparable LTV distribution to retained loans (PSI 0.03) and a comparable default rate (0.47% vs 0.45%); the exclusions are therefore not expected to affect representativeness.

1.0.heading: Data quality assessment
1.0.text: Completeness and accuracy were assessed for all 38 variables using the DQ rules of MRM-STD-022. Consistency was checked across the three source systems. All critical data elements pass the thresholds.

1.0.heading: Data deficiencies
1.0.text: The default flag for 2012–2015 was approximated from arrears data prior to the implementation of the new definition of default. Probation periods could not be reconstructed for this period.

1.0.heading: Personal data and fair treatment
1.0.text: The RDS contains personal data processed under the legal obligation of the CRR; a DPIA was completed (DPIA-2026-118). Nationality and gender are excluded. Postcode was assessed as a potential proxy and is only used at regional level within the house-price index.

1.0.heading: Reproducibility
1.0.text: The RDS is built by versioned code in repository rds-mort-nl (tag v4.0.0). A full rebuild reproduces the RDS row count and default count exactly.

draft_findings_2lod.title: Materiality threshold in code differs from documented definition of default
draft_findings_2lod.observation: RDS documentation §3.3 states EUR 100 / 1%. The RDS build script applies EUR 250 absolute (rds_build.py L214).
draft_findings_2lod.impact: Default flag understated for small arrears → PD calibration potentially too low.
draft_findings_2lod.challenge: Since when has EUR 250 been applied, and to which vintages of the RDS?

draft_findings_2lod.title: MoC category A underestimates data deficiency impact
draft_findings_2lod.observation: MDD §7.2 applies +6% for the approximated default flag 2012–2015; validation sensitivity indicates ~+11%.
draft_findings_2lod.impact: Capital requirement understated until MoC recalibrated.
draft_findings_2lod.challenge: Please provide the sensitivity analysis supporting +6%.

draft_findings_2lod.title: Representativeness not tested on default-rate levels
draft_findings_2lod.observation: §5.1 and Annex B compare risk-driver distributions only.
draft_findings_2lod.impact: Calibration may not reflect current portfolio risk level.
draft_findings_2lod.challenge: Provide default-rate comparison per segment, RDS vs 2022–2024.

draft_findings_2lod.title: Timeliness DQ dimension not assessed
draft_findings_2lod.observation: §6.1 covers completeness, accuracy and consistency only.
